positions.statement: Durable AI advantage comes from the operating system around the model — data, governance, process and ownership — rather than the model itself.
supporting_evidence: Edition 0022: Target said its AI moat was the data, governance and operating discipline around models.
Edition 0022: Enterprise AI cost waste and agent-governance failures pointed to accountability as the constraint.

events.explanation: The edition established a working position that model choice was becoming less differentiating than the systems built around it.
